messages:
Ben (marketing): Quick request for the launch + webinar: need an auditable bench bundle we can link. Deliverables: per-request CSVs, aggregated KPIs, cold vs warm profiles, and a 1-paragraph public runbook. Can you take this?

Hannah (marketing): Also want a single-slide table: model, variant, median_gen_ms (<=64 tokens), median_embed_ms, cold_p95_ms, and a pass/fail column against these demo thresholds.

bench-bot: queued job 9123 - ingesting payloads from drive:/marketing/launch/mini_pack.jsonl

Ravi (eng-runtime): We can do it. Quick clarifications: (1) which model variants? (2) exact pass/fail thresholds?

Ben (marketing): Include fp16 baseline and int8-fast kernel. Optional 3B fallback marked separately. Thresholds: gen median <= 280ms (<=64 tokens) and embed p50 <= 35ms. Mark FAIL if not met.

Tara (eng-runtime): We'll run batch=1 for slide-friendly numbers. Warm runs = 6 synthetic warmups; cold runs = strict cold. We'll include a 12% random holdout and record the RNG seed in manifest.txt. No manual cherry-picks.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Deliverables: artifacts.zip with runs/*.csv, summary.csv (p50/p90/p95/p99 + pass_fail), manifest.txt (holdout seed), runbook.md (one paragraph + example command), traces.tar.gz. ETA: Tuesday 3pm.

Ben (marketing): ETA good. Please include kernel/version used for int8 and note whether KV-cache was used. If p95 variance > 35% we'll accept a labeled rerun and keep both artifacts.

bench-bot: job 9123 -> ingest complete: 46 payloads detected, artifacts staged at /artifacts/9123

Tara (eng-runtime): Smoke run posted. Small CSV excerpt: 

```
req,variant,warmup,total_ms,model_ms,tokens
1001,fp16,false,418,403,48
1002,int8,true,198,184,30
1003,fp16,false,1275,1258,1300
```

Hannah (marketing): Looks good. Once you upload artifacts.zip, ping #marketing and paste checklist: artifacts present, manifest with seed, slide-ready summary, runbook included. We'll verify the 12% holdout with SRE before publishing numbers.

Ravi (eng-runtime): Will upload and post checklist. Example public command we'll include in runbook (edited):

```
benchctl run --model redwood-7b-v2 --variant int8 --batch 1 --warmup 6 --payloads payloads.jsonl --out runs/warm_int8.csv
```

Ben (marketing): Thanks all — we'll wait for the verified summary. If anything fails the thresholds, flag it in the slide and add a brief note about the variance. :thumbsup:
